Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent isolated WORLD-DROP EQUIPMENT sprite atlas for a finely hand-painted dark fantasy 2D game. These are physical equipment objects lying as loot in the game world, NOT inventory UI icons.
Canvas: exactly 1024×1024 RGBA PNG with actual transparent background. Invisible layout is FOUR columns by FOUR rows, each cell 256×256. Populate ONLY first THREE rows with twelve separate isolated objects, one centered in each cell; entire last row y=768–1023 must remain totally empty transparent. Object centers x=128,384,640,896 and row centers y=128,384,640. Each object's longest dimension 160–180px, with generous transparent margins, fully contained inside its cell, no touching adjacent cells.
Primary request: twelve standalone equipment objects in precise reading order:
Row 1 left to right: (1) common pale iron battle gauntlet: simple sturdy articulated steel fist and short wrist cuff, clean neutral silver-white; (2) green jade gauntlet: dark green jade plates, restrained bronze leaf-like trim, emerald inset; (3) blue silver gauntlet: blue-silver armored fist with small ice crystal facets; (4) purple rune gauntlet: deep violet dark metal fist, carved runes and small amethyst, elegant short claw tips.
Row 2 left to right: (5) red gold gauntlet: crimson and dark steel dragon-scale fist with restrained red-gold trim; (6) orange gold gauntlet: ornate ivory-and-antique-gold heroic fist with orange sunstone, powerful readable armored shape; (7) common white staff: robust dark brown and silver staff with clear pale quartz head; (8) green jade staff: thick twisted wooden shaft, green jade crystal head, compact leaf trim.
Row 3 left to right: (9) blue silver staff: thick dark blue-silver shaft and angular icy blue crystal head; (10) purple rune staff: substantial violet metal shaft with compact crescent and purple gemstone head; (11) red gold staff: robust black-red metal shaft with compact red dragon-shaped gemstone head; (12) orange gold staff: substantial antique-gold shaft with orange sun crystal and compact sculpted wing motif.
Style/medium: beautiful detailed original hand-painted dark fantasy 2D game equipment, consistent fine material texture and controlled painterly highlights, readable small silhouettes. Progression from simple plain iron to increasingly ornate green jade, blue silver, purple rune, red gold, orange gold. Colors belong to object material, not a rarity background. Clear near-front slightly oblique view of standalone item. Gauntlets are empty single armored gloves/fists with short cuff, no body, no severed anatomy. Staves diagonal lower-left to upper-right, chunky visible shafts (at least 12–18px wide), compact heads, not skinny needles. All six staves similar overall scale.
Transparency and negative constraints: The entire image outside exact object silhouettes is real alpha0, including all cell gaps and final row. Absolutely NO black square, dark tile, card, inventory panel, rectangle, border, frame, colored backing, glowing square, circular badge, mat, ground, pedestal, base, backdrop, cast background shadow, glow cloud, detached VFX, particle field, grid line, checkerboard, text, numerals, labels, logo or watermark. No people, hands wearing the objects, heads, skeletons or scenery. No scene lighting gradients. Only twelve beautiful isolated equipment objects on actual transparency, each fully inside its invisible 256px cell.
